summary: The root command sets SilenceErrors so a returned error is printed once, by main.go.
reason: Cobra printed `Error: <msg>` and main.go printed `<msg>` again, so every failing command (usage errors, API errors, unknown flags) showed its error twice. The same root template appears in most published CLIs.
validated_outcome: TestRootCommandDoesNotPrintReturnedErrors fails without the flag (3 cases) and passes with it.
